budgetPlan.title: Annual plan
budgetPlan.empty: No budgets or spending for this year yet.
budgetPlan.monthEmpty: No budgets or spending in this month.
budgetPlan.clearHint: Leave a cell empty to remove its budget.
budgetPlan.suggestIntro: Based on your spending from {{from}} to {{to}}. Review and edit the numbers, then apply.
budgetPlan.overwriteExisting: Replace months that already have a budget
budgetPlan.noHistory: Not enough spending history to suggest a budget yet.
budgetPlan.incomeHint: Planned income comes from your recurring income items.
budgetPlan.noIncome: No income yet. Categorize your salary, or make it a recurring item to plan it.
budgetPlan.netHint: Money in minus money out, investments and transfers included: what changed in your accounts. Under it, the planned balance (planned income minus budgets).
budgetPlan.movedHint: Money that left your accounts without being spending: put into investments or sent to banks not in Securo. Negative when more came back.
budgetPlan.monthEndHint: What your accounts really held on the last day of each month (today for this month): balances minus card debt, as in the sidebar. Under it, where the plan puts you: the money at the start of the year plus the planned balances. The Year column compares now with the plan for the year's end.

cdiYield.title: CDI yield
cdiYield.notConfigured: Off. Set a percentage of CDI and this account earns it automatically, with one "Rendimento CDI" entry per day.
cdiYield.howItWorks: Each day's yield is calculated on the previous day's balance using Banco Central's official CDI rate, and posted once that rate is published. Amounts are gross, before income tax.
cdiYield.businessDaysHint: Yield only on business days, the days CDI is published.
cdiYield.calendarDaysHint: Yield every day, weekends and holidays included, at an equivalent daily rate (same yearly result).
cdiYield.rebuildHint: Saving recalculates all yield from the start date.
cdiYield.turnOffQuestion: Turn off CDI yield. Keep the yield already posted?

recurring.nextDateHelp: The next payment expected. It can go back one period, to undo a payment linked by mistake.

rules.transferToAccountHint: Pairs each match with an opposite entry in this account: money going out lands there, money coming in is taken from there.

recurringLink.offer: Paid every month? Turn it into a recurring item.
recurringLink.followAverage: Amount follows the average of the last 3 payments
recurringLink.followAverageHelp: The expected value updates by itself when the price changes. You can turn it off and type your own.
recurringLink.followAverageToggleHelp: Updated after each linked payment. Turn it off to keep a fixed amount you type.
recurringLink.amountFollowsAverage: Set from the average of the last payments. Turn off “Amount follows the average” below to type your own.
recurringLink.createRuleHelp: Creates a rule: payments that match are linked to this item, even when the amount changes.
recurringLink.createdWithHistory_one: Recurring item created and {{count}} earlier payment linked
recurringLink.createdWithHistory_other: Recurring item created and {{count}} earlier payments linked

monthOutlook.title: This month's outlook
monthOutlook.widgetHint: Whether this month is covered: money now, bills and income still to come
monthOutlook.endOfMonth: Left at the end of the month
monthOutlook.notCovered: Not enough to cover this month
monthOutlook.startBalance: Money at the start of the month
monthOutlook.committedLaterHint: Already committed for the months ahead. Not subtracted from this month.
monthOutlook.showDetails: Show what comes in and goes out
